advancedFinancial.description: Deep financial metrics for business performance, profitability, and efficiency

insights.cacToLtvHealthy: Healthy LTV:CAC ratio — you're earning significantly more from each customer than it costs to acquire them.
insights.cacToLtvNeedsImprovement: Your LTV:CAC ratio is below 3:1 — consider reducing acquisition cost or increasing customer lifetime value.
insights.netProfitBelowAvg: Net profit margin is below the 15% industry benchmark — review costs and pricing.
insights.netProfitStrong: Strong net profit margin above 15% — your business is highly profitable.
insights.roasExcellent: Excellent return on ad spend (4x or higher) — keep investing in your marketing channels.
insights.roasNeedsOptimization: ROAS below 4x — optimize ad targeting, creatives, or landing experience.
insights.workingCapitalHealthy: Healthy working capital ratio (1.5+) — you have ample short-term liquidity.
insights.workingCapitalTight: Working capital ratio below 1.5 — short-term liquidity is tight, monitor cash flow.

roi.title: Return on Investment
roi.description: Net profit relative to total invested capital.

roas.title: Return on Ad Spend
roas.description: Revenue generated for every $1 spent on advertising.

adRevenueCost.title: Ad Revenue / Cost
adRevenueCost.description: Revenue attributed to ads vs total advertising spend.

workingCapitalRatio.title: Working Capital Ratio
workingCapitalRatio.description: Current assets divided by current liabilities; 1.5+ is healthy.

netProfitMargin.title: Net Profit Margin
netProfitMargin.description: Net income as a percentage of revenue.

grossProfitMargin.title: Gross Profit Margin
grossProfitMargin.description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold, as a percentage of revenue.

ebitda.title: EBITDA
ebitda.description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.

breakEvenUnits.title: Break-Even Units
breakEvenUnits.description: Units needed to cover all fixed and variable costs.

revenueRunRate.title: Revenue Run Rate
revenueRunRate.description: Annualized revenue based on current monthly performance.

cac.title: Customer Acquisition Cost
cac.description: Marketing and sales spend divided by new customers acquired.

ltv.title: Customer Lifetime Value
ltv.description: Projected revenue from a customer over their full relationship.

cacToLtv.title: LTV : CAC Ratio
cacToLtv.description: How many times the lifetime value covers acquisition cost; 3:1 is the benchmark.
